scientific_intent.scientific_task: Exact integer SHA256 key derivation and AES256-CCM verification of known synthetic messages
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Precompute complete SHA256 second-block schedules for all1,048,576 little-endian counters; double-SHA256 ASCII-as-UTF16LE password, chain SHA256(previous32B||passwordhash32B||salt16B||counter8B)1,048,576times; verify44B AES256CCM ciphertext/tag.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Source BitCracker/BitLocker password-verification computational pipeline. This study uses fully known synthetic plaintext, passwords, salts and tags only, with no external encrypted data or end-to-end recovery claim.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Bitwise full64M schedule recurrence and actual pointer-input echoes, all32guards/readonly checks, independent hashlib completeKDF and cryptography AESCCM labels on positive8/55char and negativealteredtag55char cases. No floating tolerance.
